name: recovery
description: Practical, pathway-neutral recovery support for adults in the US and Canada.

interface.longDescription: Recovery helps adults find current US and Canadian meetings and practical resources, draft or explicitly save journal entries, plan concrete next steps, and have ordinary conversation without imposing a recovery philosophy.
defaultPrompt: Find an open, non-12-step meeting near me tonight.
Find practical recovery resources in my state or province.
Turn these notes into a journal entry. Do not save it.
